function_signature: def shamir_split(secret, t, n, prime, coeffs=None) -> list; def shamir_reconstruct(shares, prime) -> int
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.85 (13 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: No third-party cryptographic/mathematical library; modular inverse by Fermat's little theorem; polynomials over GF(p) + Lagrange interpolation; 1<=t<=n, prime>n, coeffs of length t-1, anything invalid raises ValueError; determinism
source: Shamir, How to Share a Secret, CACM 1979
author: Zhou Wenquan
